title: Warm Grassy Mexican Melon Bake
description: A refreshing post-workout Mexican dish featuring melons and a blend of Mediterranean flavors, with a grassy and shattering texture from toasted pumpkin seeds and crispy tortilla strips. This Chiapan-inspired bake is perfect for a light dinner or snack.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine diced cantaloupe and honeydew melon.
In a small skillet, toast pumpkin seeds over medium heat until fragrant and lightly browned.
Add toasted pumpkin seeds, crispy tortilla strips, crumbled feta cheese, and chopped cilantro to the bowl with the melon mixture.
In a small bowl, whisk together lime juice and olive oil.
Pour the lime juice and olive oil mixture over the melon mixture and toss to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
